summary: Odyssey Health, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting two promissory note amendments dated September 29, 2026, extending maturities to January 31, 2027. Amendment No. 13 to the $1,050,000 convertible note with LGH Investments, LLC, originally dated April 5, 2021, also changes the interest rate and conversion rate. Amendment No. 1 with accredited investor Peter J. D'Arruda extends his October 1, 2025 note. This is a routine debt-restructuring amendment, not a special situation. What to watch: potential dilution if the convertible note converts at revised rates.
